objects.name: Analytic 2111
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor software package whose installation, via package manager, creates unexpected files or starts unrecognized services not documented in the vendor's package manifest. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
